title: The Easiest Way to Upgrade Claude (Hidden Library)
description: Anthropic has an official skills library and barely anyone talks about it. It's free, open source, and probably the easiest way to upgrade Claude right now. The repo lives on GitHub. It's full of skills built by Anthropic for writing, coding, research, formatting, and document creation. Drop them into your Claude folder and they start working right away.
